method: Exact orbit-energy calculation on an active three-coordinate majority multiplexer, followed by central-binomial asymptotics.
bounded_objective: Test whether the independently reviewed fixed-block logarithmic potential can follow the simplest changing overlap {x,y}->{y,z} with an absolute single-use fee on the entering/leaving coordinates.
prior_status: The potential contracted for one fixed shared block, but changing overlaps could recharge an orbit; no exact changing-block theorem or counterfamily was known.
mathematical_delta: Constructed a genuine Boolean family with all overlap coordinates active for which one block swap increases the potential by (1/pi)log_2 m+O(1), while both symmetric-difference influences equal 1/2. This exactly refutes every absolute local swap fee based only on those coordinates.

verification.scope: Exact rational orbit energies and influences for finite direct cases; exact central-binomial formula plus analytic Stirling asymptotic for the family.

remaining_obstacle: A global signed payment may charge the whole transported slice or total private-core influence; the local no-go does not decide SMR, GU, or FEI.
next_action: Transport the complete entering-coordinate slice through a second overlap swap and test a signed K_i-Gamma_i charge against total private influence without double spending.
